name: Eugene Winter Cubing 2024
information:
# This competition has been cancelled due to weather.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EugeneCubing2023#17662-competitor-responsibilities) tab. 

**Join our facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!**
